integrity: The exact finite formula follows planar moment and polygon clipping identities. The uniform fourth-order asymptotic remainder follows an angular-cell cancellation estimate, not the checker. All numerical assertions are finite and do not constitute an infinite certificate.
scientific_limitations: Uniform area measures on regular inscribed planar polygons, affine polynomial space only; no assertion for higher degrees, nonregular domains or interior L^p. A historical hexagonal source was not fully accessible, so historical priority is not independently established.
title: Sharp affine projection norms on regular polygons and their disk-limit excess
